migration_cadence_reason: Single first-party file; parallel stable target not worth the overhead.

blockers.reason: CMake FetchContent_Declare(repo-fastscale GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/example/fastscale GIT_TAG v0.3.1) sources are compiled into the shipped wheel, but build/_deps/ is empty and the assess run had no network access to fetch them. They could not be audited or migrated; the wheel cannot ship as ABI-stable until they are.
remediation_options: Re-run assess-abi-migration on a host with network access after 'cmake -S . -B build' populates build/_deps/
Upstream the stable-ABI migration via PRs to example/fastscale and bump GIT_TAG
Fork-and-patch: vendor the sources under csrc/third_party/ with the migration applied
